cards.ex: I'm totally hooked on this new TV series; I can't stop watching it!
cards.exUz: Men bu yangi serialga butunlay qaram bo'lib qoldim; uni tomosha qilishni to'xtata olmayapman!
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga juda qattiq bog'lanib qolish, undan voz kechish qiyin bo'lish.

cards.ex: He's trying to kick the habit of smoking, but it's really tough.
cards.exUz: U chekish odatini tashlashga harakat qilyapti, lekin bu juda qiyin.
cards.uzDef: Yomon odatdan voz kechish, uni to'xtatish.

cards.ex: He was sober for a year, but sadly, he fell off the wagon last month.
cards.exUz: U bir yil davomida ichmagan edi, ammo afsuski, o'tgan oy yana ichishni boshladi.
cards.uzDef: O'zini tutishni to'xtatib, yomon odatga qaytish.

cards.ex: She's completely dependent on her parents for financial support.
cards.exUz: U moliyaviy yordam uchun butunlay ota-onasiga bog'liq.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga yoki kimdirga muhtoj bo'lib qolish, ularsiz yashay olmaslik.

cards.ex: Many teenagers are addicted to social media and their phones.
cards.exUz: Ko'p o'smirlar ijtimoiy tarmoqlar va telefonlariga mukkasidan ketgan.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga juda qattiq berilib ketish, undan voz kechishning iloji bo'lmaslik.

cards.ex: For him, alcohol became a crutch to deal with his anxiety.
cards.exUz: U uchun alkogol tashvish bilan kurashish uchun tayoq bo'lib qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin vaziyatda yordam beradigan, lekin aslida muammoni hal qilmaydigan narsa.

cards.ex: I know I shouldn't eat it, but I can't help myself; it's so delicious!
cards.exUz: Bilaman, uni yemashim kerak, lekin o'zimni tiya olmayman; u juda mazali!
cards.uzDef: O'zini biror narsadan to'xtata olmaslik, iroda yetishmasligi.

cards.ex: Missing one deadline can be a slippery slope to failing the whole course.
cards.exUz: Bir muddatni o'tkazib yuborish butun kursdan o'tib keta olmaslikka olib kelishi mumkin bo'lgan sirpanchiq yo'l bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Kichik bir xato keyin katta muammolarga olib kelishi mumkin bo'lgan vaziyat.

cards.ex: He decided to quit smoking cold turkey, and it was incredibly difficult.
cards.exUz: U chekishni birdaniga tashlashga qaror qildi va bu juda qiyin bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Biror odatni birdaniga, hech qanday tayyorgarliksiz tashlash.

cards.ex: I tried to resist, but I eventually gave in to my cravings for chocolate.
cards.exUz: Men qarshilik ko'rsatishga harakat qildim, lekin oxir-oqibat shokoladga bo'lgan ishtahimga taslim bo'ldim.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga qarshilik ko'rsatishni to'xtatib, unga taslim bo'lish.

cards.ex: She's been struggling with alcohol addiction for many years.
cards.exUz: U ko'p yillar davomida alkogolga qaramlik bilan kurashib kelmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa bilan qiyinchilik bilan kurashish, uni yengishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: He was finally able to escape the grip of addiction after years of therapy.
cards.exUz: Uzoq yillik terapiyadan so'ng u nihoyat qaramlik qo'lidan qutula oldi.
cards.uzDef: Qaramlikning kuchli ta'siri ostida bo'lish.

cards.ex: His behavior was self-destructive, pushing away all his friends and family.
cards.exUz: Uning xatti-harakati o'zini yo'q qiluvchi edi, barcha do'stlari va oilasini uzoqlashtirardi.
cards.uzDef: O'ziga zarar yetkazadigan xatti-harakatlar qilish.

cards.ex: Hitting rock bottom was the wake-up call he needed to turn his life around.
cards.exUz: Tubiga tushish uning hayotini o'zgartirish uchun kerak bo'lgan uyg'onish qo'ng'irog'i edi.
cards.uzDef: Eng yomon ahvolga tushib qolish, umidsizlik cho'qqisiga yetish.

cards.ex: I have a craving for something sweet after dinner.
cards.exUz: Kechki ovqatdan keyin shirinlikka ishtiyoqim bor.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani juda xohlash, unga bo'lgan kuchli istak.

cards.ex: You can enjoy sweets, but only in moderation.
cards.exUz: Siz shirinliklardan bahramand bo'lishingiz mumkin, lekin faqat me'yorida.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani ortiqcha qilmasdan, me'yorida iste'mol qilish.

cards.ex: Relapse prevention is crucial for long-term recovery.
cards.exUz: Uzoq muddatli tiklanish uchun qaytalanishning oldini olish juda muhimdir.
cards.uzDef: Yomon odatga qaytib ketishning oldini olish choralari.

cards.ex: He experienced severe withdrawals when he stopped taking the medication.
cards.exUz: U dori-darmonlarni qabul qilishni to'xtatganda og'ir ajralish alomatlarini boshdan kechirdi.
cards.uzDef: Biror moddadan voz kechganda paydo bo'ladigan noqulay alomatlar.

cards.ex: He started smoking because of peer pressure from his friends.
cards.exUz: U do'stlarining tengdoshlari bosimi tufayli chekishni boshladi.
cards.uzDef: Tengdoshlar tomonidan biror narsa qilishga majburlash.

cards.ex: By giving him money, you're just enabling his gambling addiction.
cards.exUz: Unga pul berib, siz uning qimorga qaramligini qo'llab-quvvatlayapsiz.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir yomon odatini davom ettirishga yordam berish, uni o'zgartirishiga to'sqinlik qilish.

cards.ex: It's important to seek help if you're struggling with addiction.
cards.exUz: Agar siz qaramlik bilan kurashayotgan bo'lsangiz, yordam so'rash muhim.
cards.uzDef: Muammo yuzaga kelganda yordam izlash, professionalga murojaat qilish.

cards.ex: He's in denial about his drinking problem; he doesn't think he has one.
cards.exUz: U ichkilik muammosini inkor etmoqda; u o'zida bunday muammo bor deb o'ylamaydi.
cards.uzDef: Muammoni tan olmaslik, uni inkor etish.

cards.ex: It took her years to break free from the abusive relationship.
cards.exUz: Unga zo'ravon munosabatlardan ozod bo'lish uchun yillar kerak bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning ta'siridan qutulish, ozod bo'lish.

cards.ex: He was stuck in a vicious cycle of debt and depression.
cards.exUz: U qarz va depressiyaning yopiq doirasida qolib ketgan edi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin vaziyatdan chiqishning iloji bo'lmagan doira.

cards.ex: This article contains a trigger warning for discussions of addiction.
cards.exUz: Ushbu maqolada qaramlik haqida muhokamalar uchun ogohlantirish mavjud.
cards.uzDef: Ma'lum bir mavzu odamni xafa qilishi mumkinligi haqida ogohlantirish.

cards.ex: He's been clean and sober for five years now.
cards.exUz: U besh yildan beri toza va sog'lom hayot kechirmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Giyohvand moddalar yoki alkogolsiz hayot kechirish.

cards.ex: Overeating can be a coping mechanism for dealing with stress.
cards.exUz: Haddan tashqari ovqatlanish stressni engish uchun yengish usuli bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Stress yoki qiyinchiliklarni yengish uchun ishlatiladigan usul.

cards.ex: He started to self-medicate with alcohol to deal with his anxiety.
cards.exUz: U tashvishini bartaraf etish uchun alkogol bilan o'zini-o'zi davolashni boshladi.
cards.uzDef: Professional yordamsiz o'zini dori-darmonlar bilan davolash.

cards.ex: Teenagers from troubled homes are often at risk of drug abuse.
cards.exUz: Muammoli uylardan kelgan o'smirlar ko'pincha giyohvand moddalarni suiiste'mol qilish xavfi ostida bo'lishadi.
cards.uzDef: Yomon narsa sodir bo'lishi ehtimoli yuqori bo'lgan vaziyatda bo'lish.

cards.ex: When he felt stressed, he would turn to video games to relax.
cards.exUz: U stressni his qilganda, dam olish uchun video o'yinlarga murojaat qilardi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin vaziyatda yordam izlash uchun biror narsaga murojaat qilish.
